title: Chris's 'Rosetta Stone' project to decode the phenomenon with sensors and quantum AI

tellings.quote: I think we can get actual real time communication through the light and through sensors if we can gather enough data.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs show up around him as lights, describes a project he calls a "Rosetta Stone", after the ancient stone that helped decode Egyptian writing. He says that between about 2025 and 2030 he hopes to gather enough data with sensors and quantum computing AI to achieve real-time communication through the lights. If it worked, it would mean a two-way conversation with whatever is behind them.
